title: Hoot, the fridge reminder owl
hook: The fridge owl that blinks at you until you've taken your meds and had your water.
intro: Hoot is a yellow owl-shaped fridge magnet with two reminders. Its left wing is a button marked "meds", its right wing "water". Press a wing when you have done the thing: that eye glows and its timer restarts. When the reminder comes due again (meds every 24 h or 12 h, water every 2 h), that orange LED eye blinks until you press. An ATtiny412 sleeps in power-down between one-second RTC ticks, so a CR2032 lasts about 14 months of typical use. Gold ENIG eye rings and beak on yellow mask; magnets go on the flat back.
what: **Reminders:** meds (left wing, left eye) every 24 h, or 12 h by holding the wing 3 s; water (right wing, right eye) every 2 h.
**Due:** that eye flashes every 2 s; after an hour unanswered it dozes to one flash every 10 s until a wing is pressed.
**MCU:** ATtiny412 in power-down, woken once a second by the RTC and at once by a wing (PA2/PA6, the fully asynchronous pins); UPDI pads on the chin.
**Power:** one CR2032 in a Keystone 3034 holder; about 17.5 µA on a typical day (see SPEC.md).
**Mounting:** two 8 x 2 mm disc magnets on the rings printed on the back.
